scripts.serve: bun run build && firebase emulators:start --only functions,firestore,pubsub -P dev
scripts.dev: bun run build && firebase emulators:start --only functions,firestore,pubsub --inspect-functions -P dev
scripts.shell-prep: bun run build && firebase emulators:start --only firestore,pubsub -P dev
scripts.shell: bun run build && firebase functions:shell -P dev --inspect-functions
scripts.deploy: bun run build && firebase deploy --only functions -P prod
